text:
Maya: throwing an idea out there: what if we introduce a tiny "sheriff" preflight that runs before the smoke bench to catch obvious tokenizer/ABI/shape mismatches? fast fail = less wasted bench time.
Liam: love the concept. what's the absolute-min checkset to be valuable?
Sofia: minimal = token id probes for a handful of canonical inputs, verify kv-cache shapes/dtypes, and a single-step micro-forward that checks output shape + tiny numeric sanity.
Maya: aim for <1s on a warmed worker. token probe + micro-forward -> only enqueue full bench on pass.
Alex: important caveat: micro-forward depends on kernel selection. if preflight kernel set != runtime kernel set we can get false positives. for Dedicated/Private run in matching sandbox; for hosted maybe do kernel fingerprint check + wider tolerance.
Jordan: also think about structured failure reasons so SRE/product can pivot quickly. boolean not helpful.
Liam: agreed. small schema: reason_code, component, evidence_snippet. e.g. TOKEN_MAP_MISMATCH | tokenizer | "id 403 != exp 402". keep short.
Sofia: golden compare approach: deterministic seed -> tiny input -> forward -> relative L2 vs golden tensor. threshold depends on tolerance enum (strict/medium/lenient).
Maya: default tolerance=medium; enterprise profiles can set strict. store tolerance in intake.yaml.
Alex: where to store goldens? small immutable blobs in blobstore keyed by model-family+gate_version; update via gated process.
Liam: metric idea: record entry_sheriff.fail_rate and reasons histogram. alert if >3 failed intakes in 1h.
DevOpsBot: metric.created: metric.entry_sheriff_fail_rate (1m,5m). alert rule queued.
Sofia: pseudo snippet:
```
seed=7
x=randint(seed,(1,16))
out=model.forward(x)
if rel_l2(out,golden)>THRESH: fail("GOLDEN_DELTA")
```
Alex: UX: intake API returns early verdict: {status:"queued", sheriff:{state:"pass"|"fail", reasons:[..], gate_version:"v1.0.0"}}. keep payload small.
Jordan: ops: gate-versioning required. semver the sheriff logic and persist gate_version for reproducibility.
Maya: rollout: alpha internal only (1w), opt-in beta for some hosted customers, then default for new intakes with opt-out.
Liam: docs + remediation playbook needed. I'll draft with common tokenizer fixes and re-run steps.
Sofia: I'll prototype micro-runner + compare and run tests on cpu/gpu images (PR by Fri).
Alex: ensure logs never contain raw weights or full tensors. only hashes and short evidence snippets. redact aggressively.
Maya: action items: Liam=docs/schema (EOD Wed); Sofia=prototype+tests (PR Fri); Alex=tolerance semantics (sync Thu); Ops=gate-versioning+metrics.
DevOpsBot: reminder: intake-workers pool maintenance tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Maya: noted. avoid heavy canary runs in that window. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
